To determine the reasons for measurement differences in partially matched surgery  
Assumptions                              (available program management guides (FMG), circulated team study and no method for retrospective data purge/bias
Research design                     (Replicate the execution and participation/observation of the allocated process in 5-6 indefinite hospitals); Bayes 63; propensity matching.
Provided  data or evidence needed    (Execution and observation time series data of the nominally matched activity)
Measurement                                 (Continuously monitor the procedure execution time)
